address: 2F, Hôtel du Parc, 84 Tran Nhan Tong Street, Nguyen Du Ward, Hai Ba Trung District, Hanoi, 113000, Vietnam
bio: Located on the 2nd floor of Hôtel du Parc, bask in the elegant main dining room or watch the sushi chefs at work from the blonde wooden counter. The menu covers all the bases and is great value for money at lunchtime. The extensive à la carte menu offers a fine range of Kaiseki options. Don't overlook the house specialities, including the knockout sushi and sashimi. A smooth, professional operation run by a smart, friendly team....
